observed_symptoms: The public unit card for room 4058 opened the topic גלריה כללית instead of the unit topic.
The merged general gallery contained 29 images, including stale media 36a7dbc119305d.jpg, while the legacy page contains 28 images.
The merged general gallery placed 40698c5cb050d7a.jpeg last while the legacy page places it first.

hypotheses.statement: The supplier API is missing or misclassifying the unit images.
hypotheses.evidence: The live supplier detail exposes the exact legacy unit inventories: 5 images for room 4058 and 7 images for room 4064 in the correct order.

hypotheses.statement: Source-level de-duplication removes unit identity whenever the same image exists in a supplier gallery.
hypotheses.evidence: gallery-experience filtered unitItems against groupedSources before topic selection, so every shared unit image disappeared and resolvedInitialTopic fell back to the general gallery.

hypotheses.statement: Bundled presentation hydration can restore stale media and bundled order even when runtime images are current.
hypotheses.evidence: The accepted runtime summary contains 34 current images without 36a7dbc119305d.jpg, while the bundled general group contained the stale image and a different order. The previous merge returned that bundled group wholesale.

hypotheses.statement: The gallery mismatch is caused by unavailable image files.
hypotheses.evidence: All 34 unique current media paths returned HTTP 200 or 206.

fix: Gallery identity is now de-duplicated by category, topic and source, and unit items are retained even when their source is shared with a supplier gallery.
A non-empty accepted runtime image list is authoritative. Bundled groups may hydrate missing metadata only after stale media is removed.
The general group is ordered by the accepted runtime list, while named supplier groups keep their editorial order.
Non-empty runtime room images are authoritative and bundled room media is used only when runtime room media is absent.
